entries.title: Nehemiah 11:1
segments: ¶Now the leaders of the people dwelt at Jerusalem; the rest of the people cast lots to bring one out of ten to dwell in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine-tenths [were to dwell] in [other] cities.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:2
segments: And the people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:3
segments: These [are] the heads of the province who dwelt in Jerusalem. (But in the cities of Judah everyone dwelt in his own possession in their cities-Israelites, priests, Levites, Nethinim, and descendants of Solomon's servants.)

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:4
segments: Also in Jerusalem dwelt [some] of the children of Judah and of the children of Benjamin. The children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:5
segments: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col-Hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:6
segments: All the sons of Perez who dwelt at Jerusalem [were] four hundred and sixty-eight valiant men.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:7
segments: And these are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah;

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:8
segments: and after him Gabbai [and] Sallai, nine hundred and twenty-eight.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:9
segments: Joel the son of Zichri [was] their overseer, and Judah the son of Senuah [was] second over the city.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:10
segments: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, and Jachin;

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:11
segments: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, [was] the leader of the house of God.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:12
segments: Their brethren who did the work of the house [were] eight hundred and twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:13
segments: and his brethren, heads of the fathers' [houses, were] two hundred and forty-two; and Amashai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:14
segments: and their brethren, mighty men of valor, [were] one hundred and twenty-eight. Their overseer [was] Zabdiel the son of [one of] the great men.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:15
segments: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:16
segments: Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the heads of the Levites, [had] the oversight of the business outside of the house of God;

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:17
segments: Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, the leader [who] began the thanksgiving with prayer; Bakbukiah, the second among his brethren; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:18
segments: All the Levites in the holy city [were] two hundred and eighty-four.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:19
segments: Moreover the gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren who kept the gates, [were] one hundred and seventy-two.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:20
segments: ¶And the rest of Israel, of the priests [and] Levites, [were] in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:21
segments: But the Nethinim dwelt in Ophel. And Ziha and Gishpa [were] over the Nethinim.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:22
segments: Also the overseer of the Levites at Jerusalem [was] Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha, of the sons of Asaph, the singers in charge of the service of the house of God.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:23
segments: For [it was] the king's command concerning them that a certain portion should be for the singers, a quota day by day.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:24
segments: Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, [was] the king's deputy in all matters concerning the people.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:25
segments: And as for the villages with their fields, [some] of the children of Judah dwelt in Kirjath Arba and its villages, Dibon and its villages, Jekabzeel and its villages;

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:26
segments: in Jeshua, Moladah, Beth Pelet,

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:27
segments: Hazar Shual, and Beersheba and its villages;

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:28
segments: in Ziklag and Meconah and its villages;

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:29
segments: in En Rimmon, Zorah, Jarmuth,

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:30
segments: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages; in Lachish and its fields; in Azekah and its villages. They dwelt from Beersheba to the Valley of Hinnom.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:31
segments: Also the children of Benjamin from Geba [dwelt] in Michmash, Aija, and Bethel, and their villages;

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:32
segments: in Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah;

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:33
segments: in Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim;

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:34
segments: in Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat;

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:35
segments: in Lod, Ono, [and] the Valley of Craftsmen.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:36
segments: Some of the Judean divisions of Levites [were] in Benjamin.
